PolicyInformation.PolicyName: Karnataka Electric Vehicle & Energy Storage Policy 2017 (with amendments as of 2021)
PolicyInformation.SubIndustry: Electric Vehicles, EV Components, EV Battery Manufacturing, Charging Infrastructure
PolicyInformation.BusinessSize: MSME, Large Enterprise, Mega Enterprise, Ultra Mega Enterprise, Super Mega Enterprise
PolicyInformation.PolicySummary: The Karnataka Electric Vehicle & Energy Storage Policy 2017 aims to establish Karnataka as a premier destination for the manufacturing of Electric Vehicles (EVs) and their components. Its core objectives are to attract an investment of Rs 31,000 crore, generate employment for 55,000 people, and foster a comprehensive ecosystem for electric mobility. The policy outlines strategies including special initiatives for EV manufacturing such as dedicated parks/zones, promoting a shift to EVs across private, public, and goods transport sectors, and robust support for charging infrastructure development. It also emphasizes research and development by proposing a 'Karnataka Electric Mobility Research & Innovation Centre' and skill development programs tailored for the EV industry. A comprehensive package of incentives and concessions is offered to manufacturing enterprises across all scales (from MSME to Super Mega) and to service providers for EV mobility. The policy was valid for five years from its announcement and was amended in 2021 to enhance capital subsidies and introduce a production-linked subsidy, making it more competitive and attractive for investors.
PolicyInformation.EligibilityCriteria:
Enterprises must meet specific criteria to avail of the policy benefits. Eligibility extends to new investments for establishing new enterprises, as well as for the expansion, diversification, and modernization of existing industries, provided the additional investment is at least 50% of the original investment. A key mandate is to provide a minimum of 70% employment to local people on an overall basis, with a strict requirement of 100% for Group D category roles, which is monitored for five years. The policy defines enterprise sizes based on investment cost and employment: 
- Micro, Small, and Medium (MSME) Enterprises: As per the MSMED Act, 2006.
- Large EV Enterprise: Investment in plant & machinery over Rs. 10 crore (manufacturing) or Rs. 5 crore (services), with a project cost up to Rs. 250 crore.
- Mega EV Enterprise: Project cost between Rs. 250 crore and Rs. 500 crore, with employment for at least 150 persons.
- Ultra Mega EV Enterprise: Project cost between Rs. 500 crore and Rs. 1,000 crore, with employment for at least 250 persons.
- Super Mega EV Enterprise: Project cost over Rs. 1,000 crore, with direct employment for at least 500 persons.
The entire state of Karnataka is classified as a single zone, making incentives uniformly applicable across all regions.

IncentivesAndBenefits.IncentiveName: Incentives for EV & Components Manufacturing Enterprises
IncentivesAndBenefits.Description: A comprehensive package of incentives for enterprises engaged in manufacturing Electric Vehicles and their components like motors, power trains, and power electronics kits.

Benefits.Investment Promotion Subsidy for MSMEs: Micro Enterprises: 25% of the Value of Fixed Assets (VFA), up to Rs. 15.00 lakh. Small Enterprises: 20% of VFA, up to Rs. 40.00 lakh. Medium Manufacturing Enterprises: A flat subsidy of Rs. 50.00 lakh. This is available only to units availing at least 50% of term loans on eligible fixed assets.
Benefits.Capital Subsidy for Large, Mega, Ultra M: 15% capital subsidy on VFA, disbursed in 5 equal annual payments. The subsidy on land is applicable for a maximum of 50 acres. (As per 2021 amendment).
Benefits.Production Linked Subsidy for Large, Meg: 1% subsidy on turnover for a period of 5 years from the start of commercial operations. The total subsidy is capped at 50% of VFA. (As per 2021 amendment).
Benefits.Common Fiscal Incentives: 100% exemption from Stamp Duty on property and loan documentation; Concessional Registration Charges at Rs. 1.00 per Rs. 1,000; 100% reimbursement of Land Conversion Fee; 100% exemption from electricity duty/tax for MSMEs for the first five years; and a one-time capital subsidy up to 50% for setting up Effluent Treatment Plants (ETP), capped at Rs. 50 lakh for MSMEs and Rs. 200 lakh for large enterprises.

IncentivesAndBenefits.IncentiveName: Incentives for EV Battery Manufacturing/Assembly Enterprises
IncentivesAndBenefits.Description: Specific incentives for enterprises manufacturing or assembling EV batteries, including advanced battery chemistries, cells, packs, and modules.

Benefits.Investment Promotion Subsidy for MSMEs: Micro: 25% of VFA (max Rs. 15 lakh). Small: 20% of VFA (max Rs. 40 lakh). Medium: Flat Rs. 50 lakh.
Benefits.Capital Subsidy for Large/Mega/Ultra/Sup: 15% capital subsidy on VFA over 5 equal annual payments, applicable on land up to 50 acres.
Benefits.Production Linked Subsidy for Large/Mega: 1% on turnover for 5 years, capped at 50% of VFA.
Benefits.Common Fiscal Incentives: Includes 100% Stamp Duty exemption, Concessional Registration Charges, 100% Land Conversion Fee reimbursement, 100% electricity duty exemption for MSMEs (5 years), and ETP subsidy (up to Rs. 50 lakh for MSMEs, Rs. 200 lakh for large units).

IncentivesAndBenefits.IncentiveName: Incentives for EV Charging/Swapping Infrastructure Equipment Manufacturing
IncentivesAndBenefits.Description: Incentives for enterprises manufacturing equipment and components for EV charging or battery swapping infrastructure.

Benefits.Investment Promotion Subsidy for MSMEs: Identical to other manufacturing categories: Micro (25% up to Rs. 15 lakh), Small (20% up to Rs. 40 lakh), and Medium (Rs. 50 lakh).
Benefits.Capital Subsidy for Large/Mega/Ultra/Sup: 15% capital subsidy on VFA over 5 years (land up to 50 acres).
Benefits.Production Linked Subsidy for Large/Mega: 1% on turnover for 5 years, capped at 50% of VFA.
Benefits.Common Fiscal Incentives: Includes 100% Stamp Duty exemption, Concessional Registration Charges, 100% Land Conversion Fee reimbursement, 100% electricity duty exemption for MSMEs (5 years), and ETP subsidy (up to Rs. 50 lakh for MSMEs, Rs. 200 lakh for large units).

IncentivesAndBenefits.IncentiveName: Incentives for EV Adoption and Service Providers
IncentivesAndBenefits.Description: Incentives to promote the use of EVs and support service providers in a mobility ecosystem.

Benefits.Tax Exemption for EV Owners: 100% exemption from payment of taxes on all-electric non-transport and transport vehicles, including e-rickshaws and e-carts, under the Karnataka Motor Vehicles Taxation Act 1957, effective from April 1, 2016.
Benefits.Capital Subsidy for Fast Charging Statio: 25% capital subsidy on equipment/machinery, up to a maximum of Rs. 10,00,000 per station. This is available for the first 100 fast charging stations in the state for 2-wheelers, 3-wheelers, cars, and buses.
Benefits.Capital Subsidy for Battery Swapping Sta: 25% capital subsidy on charging equipment/machinery. The maximum subsidy per station is Rs. 3,00,000 for 2/3-wheelers (first 100 stations), Rs. 5,00,000 for electric cars (first 50 stations), and Rs. 10,00,000 for electric buses (first 50 stations).

PolicyGoals: To make Karnataka a preferred investment destination for the manufacturing of Electric Vehicles (EVs).
To make Karnataka a preferred destination for the development of Electric Mobility.
To promote a conducive manufacturing ecosystem in collaboration with the industry.
To develop human capital to meet the needs of the EV industry.
To maintain Karnataka's lead share in attracting investments for EV manufacturing.
To attract investments of Rs 31,000 crore and create 55,000 employment opportunities in the EV sector.
To create a conducive environment for the transition from Internal Combustion (IC) engines to Electric Vehicles.
To provide opportunities for developing Research & Development in Electric Mobility.
